name: Odmit
description: A free, private to-do app — lists, sharing, tags, and recurring tasks. Installable as a PWA.

name: Asura
description: An idle tower defense game in sumi-e ink. Play the Asura, the water-dancing Daeva or the Sorcerer, who casts arcane bolts, flame, lightning and ice on mana, at the centre; ninja, samurai, oni and tengu come from every side. Installable app, plays offline.

name: Inkborne
description: A turn-based JRPG demo in sumi-e ink. Chain timed brushstrokes, fill the Vermilion Ink gauge and unfurl into a winged Inkwing form to stop the Blot unwriting the world. Installable app, plays offline.
